title: Buying a Home in Central Texas? Don’t Make These Negotiation Mistakes in 2026
description:
Are you losing negotiation power when buying a home in Central Texas? Many buyers unknowingly weaken their position before they even make an offer.

In this episode, we break down common mistakes that reduce your leverage and how to protect yourself in today’s Central Texas real estate market.

If you're planning to buy a home in Killeen, Temple, Belton, or surrounding areas, this advice can save you thousands.

In this episode:
• Common negotiation mistakes buyers make
• How to keep leverage in a competitive market
• What weakens your offer
• How to strengthen your buying position
